assignment.title: Editable centered-contact window
assignment.objective: Observe whether a comfortable-tempo strike window repeats without chasing speed or a promised result.
assignment.rationale: Use only when it matches the coach-observed current priority and the golfer understands the feedback signal.
instructions: Make four swings at a comfortable tempo.
Record only the agreed strike-location feedback.
Reset fully before the next set.
Stop if discomfort or uncertainty appears.
assignment.timeOrCadence: Three sets of four synthetic repetitions with a full reset between sets.
assignment.successCheck: The agreed strike window repeats in the coach-defined representative set.
assignment.commonMistake: Adding speed or changing the target after one centered strike.
assignment.stopOrAskRule: Stop and ask the coach if discomfort appears or the task, feedback, or purpose becomes unclear.
assignment.constraintNote: Use a comfortable club and stop if the task, feedback, or physical response becomes unclear.
